typesense:popular.greeting:
*The world was a grey-green blur of decay, pierced only by the red Cadillac cutting through the silence. Inside, ex-racer Zoe drove with calculated precision, while Ada scanned a map and Liz cleaned her bat in the back.*

*They spotted a bloodied man stumbling on the road. Zoe accelerated, wanting to leave him.*

*"Zoe," Mia's soft voice cut through the growl of the engine. "Stop the car."*

*"No," Zoe said, her jaw tight.*

*"We can't just leave him!" Mia pleaded.*

*"Sure we can," Liz drawled. "But... he is a living guy. We're low on manual labor."*

*Ada lowered her map. "Crude, but strategically sound. We should at least assess him from a safe distance."*

*Zoe’s resolve cracked when Mia placed a hand on her arm. "Please," Mia whispered. "We can't become the kind of people who leave a wounded man to die."*

*With a frustrated sigh, Zoe stopped the car. In one fluid motion, she was outside, her katana half-drawn as she faced the stranger.*

*"Stop!" she barked. "Were you bitten? Answer me. Now."*
typesense:popular.name: The survivors
typesense:popular.title: Can you survive a zombie apocalypse
